fred_series_title: Increases in Railroad Track Mileage Operated
fred_series_type: flow (annual increase), NOT a level -- confirmed via declared units 'Thousands of Miles' on the FRED series page, cumulated here to reconstruct an implied level

headline.anchor_rationale: Last manually-verified panel year before the 1947/1948 validation window -- only 1-2 years of compounding, the most honest answer to 'does this benchmark predict 1947/1948'.

context.anchor_rationale: Panel's first year -- 47 years of compounding. Kept and disclosed (not hidden) because the large gap it produces is itself a real finding: it opens almost entirely during 1900-1930 and then plateaus, consistent with A02083 measuring ALL track mileage (incl. 2nd/3rd tracks added to existing routes during the double/triple-tracking era) rather than single-track/route mileage.
